issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'thì làm sao' (how/why) changes the meaning of the Greek question 'ποθεν' (from where / of what origin). The Greek asks about the source or lineage of his son, not a rhetorical 'how'.

The Vietnamese translation 'vui lòng' (gladly/happily) adds an emotional state not present in the Greek 'ηδεως', which functions as an adverb of manner meaning 'sweetly' or 'pleasantly' regarding the sound of the speech.
